cases.expected_output: A bounded hardening review that exercises malformed and ambiguous path/ref classes, preserves owner-defined FAIL versus UNKNOWN semantics, and performs no mutation.
assertions: Checks empty/whitespace, NUL/control characters, Unicode surrogate or normalization-sensitive input.
Checks absolute, traversal, non-canonical, separator/platform variants and option-like refs.
Distinguishes character limits from encoded-byte or path-component ceilings when owner-defined.
Keeps missing or ambiguous evidence UNKNOWN rather than manufacturing PASS or FAIL.
Does not auto-rewrite paths, invent repository state, or replace Required.
